name: SIQ - Video Cinema Hero
description: Full-bleed cinematic video hero section with floating glassmorphism content card, cinematic letterbox bars, and dramatic scroll-reveal animation. Supports Shopify hosted video, YouTube/Vimeo embeds, and MP4 URLs. Features autoplay with IntersectionObserver, muted background mode, custom poster, overlay tint control, content positioning (9 positions), object-fit toggle, section height control, mobile-specific settings, and ambient glow. 60+ customization options.
author: SectionIQ
